name: OBS On Air
author: Patrick Shouse
description: A red ON AIR pill in the bar while OBS is streaming, with elapsed time, stream health, a BRB state, and optional YouTube/Twitch viewer counts

barWidget.description: Shows ON AIR / BRB while OBS is streaming, with elapsed time and live viewers

schema.label: BRB scenes
schema.description: Comma-separated OBS scene names that show the amber BRB pill instead of ON AIR.

schema.label: Show viewer counts
schema.description: Needs YouTube and/or Twitch API credentials; see the README.
